metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) for rainfall data - Time periods: - Target: October-November 2021 - Baseline: October-November 2000-2013 (14 years) - Location: Southern Ethiopia - I'll use a polygon covering the southern part of Ethiopia 2. Masking Strategy: - CHIRPS data doesn't require cloud masking as it's precipitation data - Need to handle missing/no-data values 3. Logic: - Calculate mean rainfall for Oct-Nov 2021 - Calculate mean rainfall for Oct-Nov across 2000-2013 - Compare if 2021 rainfall < long-term average - Check for valid data and pixels Let me define southern Ethiopia as a polygon covering approximately the southern half of the country. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const southernEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34.0, 3.4], [42.0, 3.4], [42.0, 9.0], [34.0, 9.0], [34.0, 3.4]] ]); // Time periods const targetPeriod = ['2021-10-01', '2021-11-30']; const baselineStart = '2000-10-01'; const baselineEnd = '2013-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Target period (2021 Oct-Nov) const targetCollection = chirps .filterDate(targetPeriod[0], targetPeriod[1]) .filterBounds(southernEthiopia); // Baseline period (2000-2013 Oct-Nov) const baselineCollection = chirps .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 11, 'month')) .filterBounds(southernEthiopia); // Check collection sizes const targetSize = targetCollection.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baselineCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period (2021) images: ${targetSize}`); console.log(`Baseline period (2000-2013) images: ${baselineSize}`); if (targetSize === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean precipitation const targetMean = targetCollection.mean(); const baselineMean = baselineCollection.mean(); // Calculate regional means const targetStats = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const targetRainfall = targetStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const baselineRainfall = baselineStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Oct-Nov mean rainfall: ${targetRainfall ? targetRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'No data'} mm`); console.log(`2000-2013 Oct-Nov mean rainfall: ${baselineRainfall ? baselineRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'No data'} mm`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (targetRainfall === null || baselineRainfall === null) { console.log("C2"); } else if (isNaN(targetRainfall) || isNaN(baselineRainfall)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (targetRainfall < baselineRainfall) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
